claims: The CBSE Class 10 results for 2026 Session 1 were announced on April 15, 2026.
The CBSE Class 10 2026 Session 1 results are available on cbseresults.nic.in.
The CBSE Class 10 2026 Session 1 results are available on cbse.gov.in.
CBSE Class 10 2026 Session 1 recorded a pass percentage of 93.70%.
Girls outperformed boys in CBSE Class 10 2026 Session 1.
No merit list was released for CBSE Class 10 2026 Session 1.
Merit certificates are awarded to the top 0.1% in CBSE Class 10 2026 Session 1.
A second optional board exam will be held in May 2026 for CBSE Class 10 2026 Session 1 students wishing to improve their performance.
Application fees and LOC submission for the second board exam phase are accepted from April 16 to April 20, 2026.
Girls' pass rate in CBSE Class 10 2026 Session 1 was 94.99%.
Boys' pass rate in CBSE Class 10 2026 Session 1 was 92.6%.
